faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: A starter site takes 7–10 days. A business website takes 2–3 weeks and an online store 4–6 weeks. Your quote gives an exact timeline.

faq.q: Why is ERP a custom quote?
faq.a: The price depends on which parts you need, how many branches and users you have, and whether we move old data in. After a short call we send a fixed price for each module.

faq.q: Do I own the website and the system?
faq.a: Yes. Once the final payment is made, the code, design files and your data are yours.

faq.q: What else will I pay for?
faq.a: Your domain and hosting, billed at cost. Payment gateways charge their own fee per order. Everything else is in the quote.

faq.q: Does the ERP work with more than one branch?
faq.a: Yes. Each branch has its own stock and staff, and the owner sees everything in one place, including on a phone.

terms.body:
These terms apply to every website, branding and ERP project Laurent takes on. Your written quote sets out the scope, price and timeline for your project. If the quote and these terms differ, the quote applies.

## 1. Quotes and scope
A quote is valid for 30 days. It lists what is included. Work that is not listed in the quote is extra and is quoted separately before we start it.

## 2. Payments
- Websites and branding: 50% before work starts and 50% before launch or file handover.
- ERP systems: paid in milestones, usually one per module, as set out in the quote.
- Monthly plans are paid in advance at the start of each month.
- All prices are in Pakistani rupees (PKR). Domain names, hosting, paid plugins and payment gateway fees are billed at cost.

## 3. Your content and approvals
You provide your logo, text, photos, product lists and any data we need to move into a new system. Delays in sending content or approvals move the timeline by the same amount.

## 4. Revisions
Each plan includes the revision rounds listed in it. A revision round is one combined list of changes. Extra rounds are billed at our hourly rate.

## 5. Ownership
Once the final payment is made, you own the website, the brand files and the ERP system built for you, along with your data. We may show the finished work in our portfolio unless you ask us not to.

## 6. Support after launch
Every project includes 30 days of free fixes for problems in work we delivered. New features and content changes after launch are quoted separately or covered by a monthly plan.

## 7. Hosting and third-party services
Websites and systems may rely on hosting providers, payment gateways, map or messaging services. We are not responsible for outages or changes made by those providers, but we will help you resolve them.

## 8. Cancellation
You can cancel a project at any time by writing to us. Payments for work already done are not refundable, and you receive the files completed up to that point. Monthly plans can be cancelled with 30 days' notice.

## 9. Confidentiality
We keep your business information, customer data and login details private and use them only for your project.

## 10. Contact
Questions about these terms? Write to us using the contact details on this page.
